errors.text_span: 此图表展示了不同语体中与生活工作和生理活动相关的动词二级语义域的分布。
errors.evidence: The description invents high-level categories of "生活工作" (life/work) and "生理活动" (physiological activities) which are not present in the figure. The figure actually shows two separate charts: (a) for "支配动词" (dominant verbs) and (b) for "承受动词" (patient verbs).
The description incorrectly identifies one of the x-axis categories as "科技文献" (Scientific Literature). The actual label in the chart is "传统文学" (Traditional Literature).
The vertical axis is labeled "频次" (Frequency), not "数量" (Quantity).
The description fails to mention that the figure consists of two separate subplots, (a) and (b), representing different types of verbs.
The description misses the key structural detail that within each语体 (register) category, there are two separate stacked bars, one for "男性" (male) and one for "女性" (female).

errors.text_span: 耳目较暗表示与生活/工作相关的动词，而较浅的颜色则表示与生理活动相关的动词。
errors.evidence: The description invents a color-coding scheme (dark colors for 'life/work' verbs, light colors for 'physiological activity' verbs) that does not exist in the figure. The colors correspond to specific semantic domains listed in the legend.

errors.text_span: 在新闻语体中，与生活/工作相关的大柱子高度约为 5700，与生理活动相关的大柱子则约为 2700。在科技文献语体中，与生活/工作相关的大柱子高度约为 3300，而与生理活动相关的大柱子高度约为 1500。在网络小说语体中，与生活/工作相关的大柱子高度约为 2200，而与生理活动相关的大柱子高度约为 1000。在微博语体中，与生活/工作相关的大柱子高度约为 1500，而与生理活动相关的大柱子高度约为 800。
errors.evidence: The description fabricates all the numerical values for bar heights. The actual values are shown on the chart (e.g., for News in chart (a), the totals are 469 and 4356), and do not match the reported numbers. The description is reporting on invented categories.

errors.text_span: 例如新闻语体中“与生活/工作相关”的比例为 88%， “与生理活动相关”的比例为 12%。
errors.evidence: The description invents percentages (88% and 12%) for the fabricated categories. The actual percentages shown on the chart correspond to specific colored segments within a bar (e.g., 53% and 36% for the 'female' bar in the 'News' category of chart a).

errors.text_span: 但新闻语体的柱状图明显比其他语体的柱状图更高，值也更大。
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. In both chart (a) and chart (b), the tallest bar belongs to the "网络小说" (Online Fiction) category for females, with values of 5840 and 5738 respectively, which are higher than any bar in the "新闻" (News) category.
